Excellent: The scope of the analysis is clear and questions can be fully addressed using the available data.
Good: The scope of the analysis is clear and questions can be reasonably addressed using the available data.
Adequate: The scope of the analysis is less clear, the questions can somewhat be addressed using the available data with slight modifications.
Poor: The questions are beyond the scope, cannot be reasonably addressed with the available data; need to resort to additional data or complete modification.

Excellent: Clear evidence of creative data wrangling to produce informative variables.
Good: Appropriate use of data wrangling to create sensible variables.
Adequate: Some use of data wrangling to create new variables.
Poor: No evidence of data wrangling to create any variables.

Excellent: Choice of graphs are appropriate and creative; graphs reveal useful information and tell a story. Meaningful captions and titles.
Good: Choice of graphs are appropriate; graphs reveal useful information, but are not self-sufficient. Might require some explaining.
Adequate: Choice of graphs are appropriate; graphs reveal some useful information.  Might require some explaining and minor changes to titles/axes/labels, etc.
Poor: A lack of visual aid; graphs are inappropriate, reveal no information.

Excellent: The choice of method is appropriate; analyses are complete; diverse and creative use of more than one approach.
Good: The choice of method is appropriate; some  non-essential analyses are missing
Adequate: The choice of method is somewhat appropriate; some analyses are missing.
Poor: The choice of method is inappropriate; essential analyses are missing.

Excellent: Results are clearly and completely summarized. Appropriate limitations and concerns clearly stated.
Good: Results are completely summarized. Some limitations and concerns are stated.
Adequate: Some results are summarized. The conclusion is not appropriate and no mentioning of any limitations.
Poor: Results are not summarized and conclusion is missing.
